hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Place the first element in arr1 and the second in arr2.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For each subsequent element, append to the array with the greater last element.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Iterate from index 2 to end, compare arr1[-1] and arr2[-1], append accordingly, and return arr1 + arr2.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct simulation creating two lists and concatenating them.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for output arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement the greedy assignment accurately according to the problem rules.
